semiconductor_relevance: High — Struent Semiconductors provides comprehensive chip design and manufacturing solutions, integral to the semiconductor industry.
summary: Struent Semiconductors Private Limited is an Indian company offering end-to-end semiconductor solutions with a focus on advanced chip design and manufacturing. Their services include RTL design, verification, DFT, physical design, and analog/mixed-signal development, catering to automotive, industrial, and AI-enabled consumer applications.

regional_presence.India: Struent Semiconductors is based in India, focusing on delivering semiconductor solutions from this region.
